name: Namida Suzumeno
source:
Namida Suzumeno is a genin of Konohagakure. Namida has brown hair and eyes. Namida is a sweet and friendly girl. Like most the girls she knows, she has an interest in boys and a love of cute things. She is also rather timid and easily scared. As such, she is very reliant on her friends for emotional support. At the same time, she is very loyal to her friends and earnestly works to be of help to them. She is a member of Team 15.
